titulo: Your AI chatbot has never read a single word you typed 🔢
descripcion: Before your message reaches the model, it's cut into tokens and turned into ID numbers. The model only ever sees numbers. Full breakdown in the linked video.

escenas.texto: Your AI chatbot has never read a single word you typed.
First, your message is chopped into pieces called tokens. A word like unbelievable can become three: un, believ, able.
Then every piece is swapped for an ID number. From then on, the model only sees numbers.
A token is about three quarters of a word, and Llama three's dictionary has around a hundred and twenty eight thousand of them.
And its only job is to guess the next one. That's it.
Watch the full video, it's linked right here.
